description: Cross-corpus retrieval test set covering all 16 indexed papers, spanning machine learning, planetary science, chemistry, microelectronics, power systems, and clinical prediction. Used by scripts/compare_retrieval.py.
relevance_rule: A retrieved chunk counts as relevant only if it comes from the paper named in `paper` AND its text contains ALL phrases in must_contain (case-insensitive). Retrieval runs over the WHOLE corpus, unscoped, so a query must find the right paper among all 16 before it can find the right passage - the realistic multi-document case, and the one where a purely semantic retriever is most likely to drift into a neighbouring paper on a similar topic.
